title: Classic Ukrainian Pasta Frittata
description: A creative twist on traditional Italian pasta dishes, this Ukrainian-inspired pasta frittata combines silky pasta with juicy Ukrainian sausage, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Cook the silky and juicy pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Cook the Ukrainian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt. Stir in the shredded cheese.
Add the cooked pasta to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Add the cooked Ukrainian sausage to the pasta mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the pasta and sausage mixture into a greased 9-inch (23cm) pie plate or skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown on top.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
